jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.

The Lunenburg Public Schools seeks a motivated individual to serve as an evening custodian.  

Location: Lunenburg Middle/High School
1079 Mass Ave Lunenburg MA  01462

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to): 
- Cleaning classrooms, hallways, and restrooms.
- Work will include sweeping, dry mopping, vacuuming, washing, and disinfecting.
- Removal of snow (typically confined to sidewalks and entryways).
- Light Maintenance

The successful candidate will be a self-starter, have excellent time management skills and have the ability/skill to interact well with people.  Light maintenance experience is preferred, but not required. 

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), year-round position, Monday through Friday, from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. 

Custodians are covered by the Lunenburg Custodial Union #503 contract--salary/benefits per this contract.  

Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.

This position will remain open until filled.
